test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Shreya prefers wearing green coloured saree on marriage funcktions.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Funcktions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Funcktions"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is** "Functions."**
 
• **​"Functions"** refers to an event or activity typically organized for a specific purpose. (कार्यक्रम)
 
 
• **Example:** She attends many social functions throughout the year.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Marriage** (शादी): The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

 
 
• **Example:** They have been happily living together since their marriage last year.
 
 
 
• **Prefers** (पसंद करना): To like one thing or person better than another; to choose one thing rather than something else.
 
 
• **Example:** She prefers tea over coffee.
 
 
 
• **Wearing** (पहनना): To have clothing, jewelry, etc., on your body.
 
 
• **Example:** He is wearing a new jacket today.
